BTW, when manually running the "curl http://get.docker.io/gpg | apt-key add -" command, it fails because of an HTTP redirect. Adding -L to curl would be a fix/workaround, but I don't know how to pass it inside of "provision 'docker'" command.

@svlasov It looks like the docker team reverted whatever change was throwing the 301 Redirect. I'm able to curl that url now. This may be a non-issue.

However, I would recommend changes be made to the provisioner logic to handle 301s, as we can't expect the docker team to not implement HTTPS unilaterally in the near term.

curl -sSL https://get.docker.com/ | apt-key add -
